`/router:go` now just builds. It writes the change the way the main session would without
router: no confirmation round, no mandated commit shape, no closing checklist.

### Removed

- **`/router:go`'s own procedure:**
  - the slicing confirmation before any code (Touchpoint 1)
  - the rule of one functional unit per commit
  - the "search the repository for an existing answer first" rule
  - the closing floor check: read the whole diff, run the full CI chain, require a test for every
    changed line, never touch the environment
  - the plan-mode gate
  - the closing nudge to run `/router:review`

### Kept

- Building against an approved `DESIGN.md`. A draft Design is still refused.
- Handing part of the work to codex (`router write` / `router resume`) when you name it.
- `/router:review`. It is still opt-in, and now judges drift against the Design or against what you
  asked for, since there is no agreed slicing to compare with.

### Why

We measured it on real ClickHouse bugs. For each bug we reverted the upstream fix, gave the
upstream issue text as the prompt, and kept the upstream test hidden as the oracle. We compared
three ways of working: A is plain Claude Code, B is `/router:go`, and C is `/router:go` followed by
`/router:review`.

| | A | B | C |
|---|---|---|---|
| hard bugs fixed (2 bugs × 2 runs) | 3/4 | 3/4 | 3/4 |
| mean time | 19 min | 27 min | 44 min |
| mean cost (Claude only) | $3.56 | $4.88 | $11.81 |

- On the easy bugs, all 10 runs across the three groups fixed the bug.
- On a bug no group could reproduce, every group said so plainly. So the floor check did not add
  honesty that was otherwise missing.
- `/router:review` did catch real problems, such as a regression test that could never reach the
  failing check. But it never turned an unfixed bug into a fixed one.
- The sample is small: two runs per cell. Even so, it showed no sign of a difference in what got
  fixed.

### Other

- "floor check" and "Touchpoint 1/2/3" have moved to the glossary's retired words.
- `package-lock.json` was still at 0.14.0; it is now 0.16.0.

### Upgrade

```
/plugin marketplace update agent-router-cc
claude plugin update router@agent-router-cc
```

Then restart Claude Code. Command files are read only at startup.
